description: Official MITRE CALDERA for OT DNP3 abilities converted for ATT&CK for ICS Collection. CALDERA is not required at runtime.

prerequisites: Morgana agent installed on an explicitly authorized execution host

Required assets downloaded from Camelot and verified by SHA256
